verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm with a client portal. A documented API for employer or HR integration is a plausible thing to ask of this kind of service, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only a secure portal for uploading documents, messaging and tracking case status, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no evidence of a public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
